name: Margaret Mahy Family Playground
description: One of the largest playgrounds in the Southern Hemisphere — towers, slides, a huge water-play area, swings and a flying fox.

name: Botanic Gardens Playground
description: Nature-themed playground inside the Botanic Gardens with climbing nets, slides and a paddling stream in summer.

name: The Groynes
description: Picnic spot with playgrounds, ponds, walking tracks and a miniature railway on some weekends. Great for bikes and scooters.

name: Halswell Quarry Park
description: Playground beside the old quarry with walking tracks, sister-city gardens and plenty of room to run.

name: Spencer Park
description: Large coastal park near the beach with a playground, big lawns and a paddling area.

name: Foster Park
description: Modern destination playground with a flying fox, climbing frames, basketball and a big open field.

name: Rawhiti Domain Playground
description: Spacious playground near the beach and the New Brighton hot pools, with swings, slides and open green space.

name: Sumner Beach Playground
description: Seaside playground right by the sand and cafés — perfect to pair with a beach day.

name: Bishopdale Park
description: Friendly neighbourhood park with a fenced playground, good for younger kids.

name: Edmonds Band Rotunda Playground
description: Riverside playground along the Avon with shade, paths for scooters and easy parking.
